description: List one page of objects and path-like prefixes, ordered by key.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

page_size.description: Maximum objects to return, from 1 to 1000.

page_token.description: Opaque continuation token from the preceding page.

prefix.description: Only return keys beginning with this prefix.

recursive.description: True for a flat listing; false for immediate children.

name: list_objects

outputSchema.description: One page of objects and the token needed to retrieve the next page.

common_prefixes.description: Immediate child prefixes when recursive is false. They behave like directories, although object storage has no real directories.

next_page_token.description: Opaque token for the next page. Pass it unchanged as page_token; null means there are no more results.

items.description: Compact information about an object returned by a listing.

etag.description: Storage entity tag; it is not always a content checksum.

last_modified.description: UTC time of the most recent modification.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

title: List Objects
